name: Valheim-broccoli
description: A dedicated server for Valheim, with crossplay, world modifiers, and optional BepInEx and Thunderstore mods. Set SERVER_PASSWORD before you start the server. Forward UDP ports 2456 and 2457 on your router. Valheim uses PORT and PORT + 1. If you change the ports, also change PORT. The server files are installed on first start. After that, they are only updated if UPDATE_ON_START is true. Docker image by indifferentbroccoli.

ports.name: Game Port 1
ports.description: UDP game port. Forward it on your router. Must be the same as PORT.

ports.name: Game Port 2
ports.description: UDP query port. Forward it on your router. Must be PORT + 1.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name of the server in the server list.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Required. Password to join. Use at least 5 characters, and do not include the server name.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: Name of the world. If no world has this name, a new world is made.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: Show the server in the server list. If false, players join with the Join IP button.

variables.name: Crossplay Enabled
variables.description: Use the crossplay backend (PlayFab) so players on all platforms can join.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players. Vanilla Valheim allows 10. Other values install BepInEx and the MaxPlayerCount mod.

variables.name: Server Preset
variables.description: World modifier preset: Normal, Casual, Easy, Hard, Hardcore, Immersive, or Hammer. It replaces earlier modifiers.

variables.name: Modifier: Combat
variables.description: veryeasy, easy, hard, or veryhard. Leave empty for the preset value.

variables.name: Modifier: Death Penalty
variables.description: casual, veryeasy, easy, hard, or hardcore. Leave empty for the preset value.

variables.name: Modifier: Resources
variables.description: muchless, less, more, muchmore, or most. Leave empty for the preset value.

variables.name: Modifier: Raids
variables.description: none, muchless, less, more, or muchmore. Leave empty for the preset value.

variables.name: Modifier: Portals
variables.description: casual, hard, or veryhard. Leave empty for the preset value.

variables.name: No Map
variables.description: Disable the map (true or false).

variables.name: Player Events
variables.description: Base raid events on players instead of the world (true or false).

variables.name: Passive Mobs
variables.description: Make mobs passive (true or false).

variables.name: No Build Cost
variables.description: Disable building costs (true or false).

variables.name: Fire Hazards
variables.description: Let fire spread and set fire to what it touches (true or false).

variables.name: Save Interval
variables.description: Seconds between world saves.

variables.name: Keep Backups
variables.description: Number of automatic backups to keep.

variables.name: Backups Short
variables.description: Seconds before the first automatic backup.

variables.name: Backups Long
variables.description: Seconds between the later automatic backups.

variables.name: BepInEx Enabled
variables.description: Enable BepInEx modding (true or false).

variables.name: BepInExPack Version
variables.description: BepInExPack_Valheim version to install when BepInEx is needed.

variables.name: Mods
variables.description: Comma-separated Thunderstore dependency strings, for example Azumatt-AAA_Crafting-2.1.6. If set, BepInEx is enabled.

variables.name: Beta Branch
variables.description: Steam branch to install, for example default_old. Use public for the stable branch.

variables.name: Update On Start
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD on each start (true or false). The server is always installed on first start.

variables.name: Port
variables.description: Game port the server listens on. The server also uses PORT + 1. Must be the same as Game Port 1.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file permissions.
